name: usage-footer
description: See your Claude Code usage limits and prompt cache at a glance in the terminal footer, and stop paying for cold caches: idle conversations are compacted 5 minutes before the cache expires, and Claude gets a compact tool so long unattended work can compact between steps and carry on. Usage is account-wide (5-hour and 7-day, all tabs and devices), with the cost of your next message. Based on ribbon by Jay E (RoboNuggets).

auto_compact.title: Compact idle conversations
auto_compact.description: Compact a conversation that has sat idle 3 minutes before its prompt cache expires, so coming back to it later stays cheap.

compact_tool.title: Let Claude compact
compact_tool.description: Give Claude a tool to compact the conversation itself, for example between the steps of a long task you are not watching.
